commits.title: Add changelog capture scenes script for rendering synthetic documentation
commits.before_text: Release evidence relied on earlier capture/editor behavior, and the Management page loaded unrelated tab data. Form-editor and festive-effect interactions used their previous handling.
commits.after_text: Adds offline exact-revision capture for UI, documentation and behavior reports; all-change evidence requirements, actionable draft recovery, automatic publication and paginated comparison editors. Management isolates changelog queries. Also includes form-editor and festive-effect refinements, v56.6-v56.8 evidence and regression coverage.

comparisons.title: Changelog comparison editor
comparisons.before_text: The evidence editor listed all three synthetic changes on one page.
comparisons.after_text: The editor shows two changes per page with navigation and guidance to save before switching.
comparisons.capture_note: Packaged ui capture, recipe changelog-editor. Exact Git snapshots; synthetic fixtures; external traffic and page scripts blocked.

comparisons.title: Seasonal sign-in — mobile
comparisons.before_text: The previous rendered sign-in screen on a narrow viewport.
comparisons.after_text: The updated sign-in screen on the same narrow viewport.
comparisons.capture_note: Packaged ui capture, recipe login-layout. Exact Git snapshots; synthetic fixtures; external traffic blocked. Only the historical decoration script rendered a reduced-motion frame.
